user.title: Connect to Crowdergy
user.description:
Crowdergy shifts your devices' consumption into cheap and solar-rich hours. To do that, link Home Assistant to your Crowdergy account.

Enter the pairing code from the Crowdergy app (Settings → Connection).

Learn more: [crowdergy.de](https://crowdergy.de)

data_description.pairing_code: Valid for 15 minutes, single use. Dashes don't matter.

location.title: Location
location.description: Your location links your home to the anonymous district map and provides the weather data for planning. Only district, city and region are stored — never an exact address.

data_description.entity_outdoor_temp_c: Your own outdoor sensor in °C. Leave empty to use weather-service data for your district.

setup_mode.title: Setup style
setup_mode.description:
How would you like to add your devices?

• **Auto-Setup** — Crowdergy detects your devices automatically; you review and confirm.
• **Manual** — you add each device step by step. Best for custom setups (Modbus, MQTT).

auto_confirm.title: Detected devices ({device_count})

device_type.title: Device #{device_number}
device_type.description:
Each device type is planned differently — pick the matching type and a name.

• Solar — PV system
• Battery — home storage
• Wallbox — EV charging
• Heating — heat pump / heating
• Hot water — DHW heat pump / boiler
• Air conditioning — cooling
• Grid — grid connection / main meter
• Household — non-controllable base load
• Other — additional switchable loads (pool, infrared, …)

data_description.device_name: Display name in the Crowdergy app and in Home Assistant.

vendor_preset_pick.title: Matching device profiles
vendor_preset_pick.description: For this device type ({device_type}) there are already {count} verified profiles from other Crowdergy users. A profile pre-fills the mapping — you can still adjust it afterwards.

device_config_mode.title: {device_name} — Control style
device_config_mode.description:
How is the device integrated in Home Assistant? This determines how Crowdergy reads and controls it.

• **Climate entity** — temperature, control and modes live in one thermostat entity (e.g. Daikin, Mitsubishi).
• **Manual** — sensors and switches are linked individually (e.g. SG-Ready, Modbus).

device_entities.title: {device_name} — Sensors & control
device_entities.description: This mapping tells Crowdergy when the device produces or consumes how much energy — the basis for planning and savings. The more complete, the better. Leave missing fields empty.

data_description.entity_current_power_kw: Current power in W or kW.
data_description.invert_power_sign: Enable if your sensor reports the directions swapped.

read_section.name: Readings
read_section.description: Read-only — Crowdergy never writes to these.

data_description.entity_current_power_kw: Current power in W or kW. Grid/battery: import / discharge direction. Solar/heat pump/wallbox: the only direction.
data_description.entity_current_power_kw_2: Grid and battery only: export / charge. Leave empty if one sensor reports both directions with a sign.
data_description.invert_power_sign: Enable if your sensor reports the directions swapped.
data_description.entity_soc_percent: State of charge in % — required for battery and wallbox. Without it Crowdergy can't tell how much can still be charged.
data_description.entity_vehicle_status: Reports whether a car is plugged into the wallbox. Charging is only planned with a car plugged in.
data_description.entity_current_temp_c: Current temperature in °C — heating flow or tank temperature.
data_description.entity_energy_total: Cumulative kWh meter — the basis for daily stats and savings. Grid: import. Battery: discharge. Otherwise: the device's own meter.
data_description.entity_energy_discharged_total: Grid (export) and battery (charge) only. Leave empty for other device types.
data_description.entity_home_consumption_pv_power: Vendor sensor of some inverters (e.g. Kostal 'Home Consumption from PV'). Refines the house-consumption chart — otherwise leave empty.
data_description.entity_home_consumption_battery_power: Vendor sensor: house consumption currently covered by the battery. Refines the house-consumption chart.
data_description.entity_home_consumption_grid_power: Vendor sensor: house consumption currently covered by the grid. Refines the house-consumption chart.
data_description.entity_pv_to_battery_power: Directly measured PV→battery charge power (hybrid inverters). Optional — otherwise leave empty.

control_section.name: Control
control_section.description: This is how Crowdergy controls the device — only with your consent. Heating/AC: climate or control entity. Hot water: water-heater or control entity. Wallbox/battery: charge mode.

data_description.entity_climate: Your heat pump's thermostat entity — control and modes are derived from it. For heating, its temperature is treated as the flow temperature; map the room temperature separately as current temperature.
data_description.entity_control: Switches the device on and off — a switch, select or number (e.g. SG-Ready).
data_description.entity_current_temp_c: Heating: room temperature (required — this is how Crowdergy tracks your comfort). Hot water: tank temperature if the water-heater entity doesn't report it correctly. Manual: your temperature sensor (required).
data_description.entity_vorlauf_temp_c: Flow-temperature sensor of the heating. Improves the heat pump's efficiency estimate — leave empty if not available.
data_description.entity_vorlauf_setpoint_c: Manual control only: writable flow setpoint in °C. Crowdergy then modulates the heating smoothly instead of just on/off. Leave empty with a climate entity.
data_description.entity_charge_mode: Wallbox: charge-mode select (lock/charge/solar). Battery: operating-mode entity.
data_description.entity_wallbox_charge_current_a: Sets the charging current in amps (typically 6–16 A). Lets Crowdergy match the charging power to the solar surplus instead of always charging at full power.
data_description.entity_water_heater: Water-heater entity of your DHW heat pump — control, modes and temperature are derived from it.

device_values.title: {device_name} — Switching values
device_values.description:
Crowdergy writes these values to switch the device on and off — so it runs in cheap and solar-rich hours instead of expensive ones.

Tip: if the device is controlled via a target temperature, use the highest desired temperature as On and the lowest as Off (e.g. hot water: On = 55, Off = 40). For custom select helpers, enter the raw state value, not the display label.

data_description.value_on: Examples: SG-Ready "Raised", thermostat "heat", switch "on", target temperature "55".
data_description.value_off: Examples: SG-Ready "Lock", thermostat "off", switch "off", target temperature "40".
data_description.value_cool_on: Only for devices with a cooling function, e.g. thermostat "cool". Empty = no cooling.
data_description.entity_control_hold: Auto/Always: rewrite every 30 s — keeps devices that silently revert. Once only: for devices that trigger an action on every write.

device_charge_mode_values.title: {device_name} — Map charge modes
device_charge_mode_values.description: So Crowdergy can block charging, allow it, or follow the solar surplus: map the options of "{entity_charge_mode}". Each filled mode appears as a button in the app; empty fields are hidden.

data_description.charge_mode_value_power: Option that charges at full power (e.g. "Power", "Boost").
data_description.charge_mode_value_solar: Option that follows the solar surplus (e.g. "Solar", "Eco").
data_description.entity_control_hold: Auto/Always: rewrite every 30 s. Once only: write once.

device_battery_values.title: {device_name} — Storage control
device_battery_values.description: This lets Crowdergy charge and discharge your storage deliberately — e.g. charge in cheap hours and bridge expensive ones. Crowdergy sets a power in watts (positive = charge, negative = discharge) and an operating mode: Active (Crowdergy controls) or Passive (the inverter regulates itself).

data_description.entity_battery_mode: Select entity with one option for Active (Crowdergy controls) and one for Passive (the inverter's own regulation).
data_description.value_battery_mode_active: Option in which the storage follows the Crowdergy target.
data_description.value_battery_mode_passive: Option for the inverter's own regulation — set when Crowdergy AI is switched off.
data_description.entity_battery_power_setpoint_w: Number entity in watts. Positive = charge, negative = discharge. The inverter limits to what is feasible.
data_description.battery_setpoint_invert_sign: Enable if your inverter expects the opposite (negative = charge).
data_description.entity_control_hold: Recommended: every 30 s — some inverters silently fall back to their own regulation.

device_vehicle_status.title: {device_name} — Map vehicle status
device_vehicle_status.description: So Crowdergy only plans when a car is actually plugged in: map the states of "{entity_vehicle_status}". Separate multiple values with commas.

data_description.vehicle_status_value_plugged: States reported while a car is connected (e.g. "connected, charging").

device_shares_hardware.title: {device_name} — Shared compressor
device_shares_hardware.description: If hot water and heating use the same heat pump, Crowdergy respects their joint power limit — the two never demand more than the compressor can deliver.

data_description.shares_hardware_with_device_id: Pick the coupled heating device. Standalone unit with its own compressor: keep "no coupling".

add_more.title: Add another device?
add_more.description: The more devices Crowdergy knows, the better the planning. You can also add devices later via Settings → Crowdergy → Configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Crowdergy
reauth_confirm.description: The connection to your Crowdergy account has expired. Generate a new pairing code in the Crowdergy app ({email}) under Settings → Connection and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Crowdergy server. Please check your internet connection.
error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. Check email and password — the account is created in the Crowdergy app.
error.invalid_pairing_code: Pairing code unknown, expired or already used. Generate a new code in the Crowdergy app.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.reauth_account_mismatch: This code belongs to a different Crowdergy account. Generate a code for the original account.

abort.already_configured: This Crowdergy account is already configured on this Home Assistant instance.
abort.invalid_provision_data: Box provisioning failed: the provided pairing data is incomplete or malformed.
abort.reauth_entry_missing: The config entry to re-authenticate no longer exists.

init.title: Crowdergy — Configuration
init.description:
Manage your location and devices — or share your setup as a device profile with the community.

Learn more: [crowdergy.de](https://crowdergy.de)

edit_base_settings.title: Basic settings
edit_base_settings.description: Your location links your home to the district map and provides the weather data for planning. Your own outdoor sensor replaces the weather service.

add_vendor_preset_pick.title: Matching device profiles
add_vendor_preset_pick.description: For this device type ({device_type}) there are already {count} verified profiles from other Crowdergy users. A profile pre-fills the mapping — you can still adjust it afterwards.

contribute_preset.title: Share as device profile
contribute_preset.description: Share your verified setup anonymously with the community — others with the same hardware can set up their device with one click. Only the mapping itself is transmitted — never names, locations or measurement data.

contribute_preset_form.title: Manufacturer + model
contribute_preset_form.description: Enter manufacturer and model exactly as printed on the device. Notes are optional — e.g. firmware version or quirks.
